description.value: Non-profit-run lakeside campground on Comox Lake with a boat launch, kayak/SUP rentals, and rock climbing crags directly behind the sites; open March through November with easy road access from the village of Cumberland, putting 80 km of legendary mountain-bike singletrack within minutes of camp.

address.value: 1100 Comox Lake Road, Cumberland, BC V0R 1S0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content was successfully fetched and provides strong evidence. The site confirms the phone number (250-702-8833), address (1100 Comox Lake Road, Cumberland, BC V0R 1S0), and that the campground is actively operated by Lake Park Society under contract with the Village of Cumberland. Reservations are confirmed via an explicit online and phone booking system with 2026 season dates. A concession stand and picnic shelter rentals are listed in the site navigation, supporting food nearby and covered shelter; all other optional amenities (showers, laundry, pump, etc.) are not mentioned.
concerns: OSM record has no address field; address sourced from website (1100 Comox Lake Road, Cumberland, BC V0R 1S0).
OSM tag 'building=yes' is unusual for a camp_site — likely refers to the campground office or concession building on the property rather than the campsite area itself.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operated community campground on Vancouver Island with online reservations, on-site food, covered shelters, and nearby cycling-friendly attractions. Clear value for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Lake Park Society dedicates 1% of revenues to local Indigenous organizations and operates as a non-profit social enterprise; the campground is seasonal (approximately March to November based on booking windows).
